info.title: Gifuto API
info.summary: Curated, family-friendly anime GIF URLs for Discord bots.
info.description:
Every request needs an API key (`X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`), generated from your profile.

**Stability:** v1 only receives additions (new optional fields or endpoints). Breaking changes would ship as `/api/v2`.

**Rate limit:** 100 requests/minute per key (Trusted members can extend it to 200). On HTTP 429 the `Retry-After` header gives the delay in seconds. Standard `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` headers are sent on every response.

**Every response** carries `X-Request-Id` (quote it for support) and `API-Version`.

**Errors** always look like `{ "error": { "code": "…", "message": "…", "details"?: […], "requestId"?: "…" } }`. Rely on `code`, never on `message`.

GIFs are not hosted by Gifuto: `url` points to the original host (Tenor, Giphy, Imgur, Klipy…).
